307: /*
308:  * Native objects are compiled against the generated target vmlinux header, not
309:  * libbpf-relocated BPF CO-RE metadata. Most field-existence probes used by the
310:  * corpus should therefore fold to true when the expression compiles. CO-RE
311:  * flavor structs are the exception. Their fields exist in the source C type,
312:  * but their offsets are synthetic until libbpf CO-RE relocates them against
313:  * the target kernel BTF. Taking those branches in native C reads the synthetic
314:  * layout instead of the real vmlinux_generated_*.h layout.
315:  */
316: #define __native_bpf_core_field_exists_text(field_text) \
317:     (__builtin_strcmp((field_text), "((struct kernfs_node___old *)0)->id.id") != 0 && \
318:      __builtin_strcmp((field_text), "cgrp_new->ancestors") != 0)
319: #define bpf_core_field_exists(field...) \
320:     __native_bpf_core_field_exists_text(#field)
321: #else
322: #define bpf_core_field_exists(field...) (1)
323: #endif
